svg.title: Territory competition loop
svg.desc: The business loop around territory control. It separates actors, the invasion episode, owner eligibility, defense time, controller projection, and ownership evidence. Zone Owner controls under the declared basis TerritoryUnit. Typed predicate controls; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.owner-controls-territory. Invader contests TerritoryUnit. Typed predicate contests; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.invader-contests-territory. Clan Member may defend TerritoryUnit. Typed predicate defends; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.clan-member-defends. Open Invasion uses as input Ownership Record. Typed predicate consumes; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.operation-24. Open Invasion creates or emits Invasion. Typed predicate produces; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.operation-25. Open Invasion creates or emits InvasionOpened. Typed predicate produces; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.operation-26. Invasion contests Ownership Record. Typed predicate contests; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.invasion-contests-ownership. Invasion is constrained by Defense Window. Typed predicate governed_by; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.invasion-governed-defense-window. Invasion is constrained by Ownership Eligibility Policy. Typed predicate governed_by; authority effect blocked; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.invasion-governed-eligibility. Defend Territory uses as input Invasion. Typed predicate consumes; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.operation-27. Defend Territory creates or emits DefenseSucceeded. Typed predicate produces; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.operation-28. Ownership Record is constrained by Ownership Caducity Policy. Typed predicate governed_by; authority effect blocked; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.ownership-governed-caducity. ControllerState is constrained by Controller Metric. Typed predicate governed_by; authority effect none; owner route body-war.product-ontology-owner; relation ID body-war.relation.controller-governed-metric. Boundary: The loop does not choose the controller metric, anti-cheat strictness, caducity interval, or clan eligibility policy.
